name: ericwurth
description: Reusable Claude skills and plugins. Skills are self-contained folders you can copy or upload on their own; plugins install through the marketplace.

plugins.name: critical-thinking
plugins.description: Backward-chaining problem analysis with disciplined assumption-handling, for plans, designs, and recommendations.

plugins.name: document-forge
plugins.description: A staged production pipeline for business documents — isolated scoping and explicit acceptance criteria per stage, not one-shot drafting.

plugins.name: framework-forge
plugins.description: Hardens a framework thesis into a publishable document: verify the author's claims, ground them, draft, adversarial review, remediate, land.

plugins.name: problem-hunt
plugins.description: Finds a real, unsolved-in-practice problem in AI, adversarially kills the weak candidates, then co-brainstorms a solution.

plugins.name: storm-research
plugins.description: Turns a topic into a verified multi-perspective research briefing: five expert lenses, a contradiction map, then adversarial fact-checking.

plugins.name: skill-evolution
plugins.description: Evolves your other skills on a schedule — finds a real technique gap, proves the gain, sandboxes it, and gates promotion on your sign-off.

plugins.name: memory-vault
plugins.description: A file-based, human-gated memory system for AI agents: deliberate writes, gated promotion, quiet reads, cold-path maintenance.

plugins.name: rulegate
plugins.description: Makes project rules bind instead of decay — compiles requests into rule-compliant plans, gates execution scope, and keeps an evidence ledger.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: A senior-resource agent that owns problems end-to-end and reports in decision-queue format.

plugins.name: resumebot
plugins.description: A job-search operating system: master resume, targeting coach, Excel tracker, board scans, tailored packets, apply queue, email sync, and interview prep.
